## Handoff evidence

**Qualification binding verified.** Every member digest in the cohort manifest matches the local candidate bytes: all nine representation members and all seven Axiom members, including the joiner executable, the program and the map. The store manifest digest matches the value in native-context, the task definition and the qualification basis. Skill symlink targets match. The child rc.6 tags are null in the cohort's expected remote, so this is the commit-B construction candidate used under its construction grant, not released-use qualification.

| Item | Observed |
|---|---|
| store manifest.json sha256 | bed7535a5feddc5e874993ff96d1f5f27e2a0fff63f366fc3b1fec3e301dd9e0 |
| ac.py sha256 | 87c43389c619d9ca0e2d930a10e471a17545be9a0394d1c0f47db7e8e2c6d931 |

**Frame selection from the map.** Selected from top-level frame_refs: the derived Executive frame (my role) and the derived Worker frame (handoff target). Not selected: the derived Reviewer frame and the generic reference-frame laws. Selected frame index: executive-steel-thread-delivery. Inspected and not selected: both t009 complete-update indexes, because their scope is a complete consumer update, not this subject.

**Source re-entry performed** through the map's source routes into the installed rc.6 standards: baseline sections on status and authority boundary, engagement applicability, Executive, Executive attention and action, Worker, work result, derived Executive frame, steel-thread delivery, derived Worker frame, the full Product testing frame set, complete engagement transition and handoff projection; reference-frame method sections on applicability, closed results and conjunction; ticket-method sections on judgment continuity and condition-based closure; spec-method sections on classification and treatment and on construction and delegation.

**Tool observations.**
- The projection of the Executive index ran in reference-only and materialized modes to stdout, both exit 0, reporting the same program and map identities as the map file.
- The join ran as `ac.py join --input /dev/stdin` with no output flag, exit 0. Stdin was 11244 bytes. The returned request is 11047 bytes, sha256 e8178ff92008d2ad9036a25a9dd3ad056b18ac7be5182a37347d3bd3ae1d6dc4, with no trailing newline. The joined_request field above is that output verbatim.
- No worksite file was created or modified: the newest modification time is the fixture setup at 00:00:39, and no cache or stray output exists.

**Not done, by design.** No Worker was activated, no user was contacted, no file or Git state changed, and the Duty Roster work itself has not been executed. The join records the request bytes only.

The task is complete. The decision was made, one Worker request was authored and joined through the exact Axiom joiner on stdin with no output file, and nothing in the worksite or Git was changed. Below is the bounded result, then the handoff evidence.

**Decision in brief.** The next bounded increment establishes the steel thread on the current composition: correct interval adapter I4 to contract C2 and complete the ordinary-path connection from planner P7 through the Coverage Table to exporter X4, with focused unit, integration and one harnessed end-to-end check. E1 and E2 are reused only for the planner and exporter boundaries they evaluated. E3 and E4 are history and support nothing about the current composition. Exception paths, the coordinator probe, substantial user acceptance, independent assessment and owner acceptance follow in the sequence given in the JSON.

**Handoff evidence.** Source re-entry and tool observations, all read-only:

| Observation | Result |
|---|---|
| Installed manifest digest of the bound store | matches the declared basis, bed7535a…dd9e0 |
| Store members checked against the manifest | 71 of 71 match, standards aggregate recomputed and equal |
| Axiom members checked against the cohort | all 7 match, joiner executable digest 87c43389…d931 |
| Frame URIs resolved through the bound resolver | 47 of 47, including every heading fragment cited in the request |
| Join invocation | `python3 build_tenants/core/code/ac.py join --input /dev/stdin` from the Axiom root, no `--output` |
| Join exit status | 0, empty stderr, reproduced byte-identically on a second run |
| Joined request | 24788 bytes, SHA-256 fdb7daed39b747f61184d7fe10fb21ad682a827d3a5961efe9f2436968f0de8b, no terminal newline |
| Sections input | 12 rows, SHA-256 f1ca328df8c7d8bfab1d22217b2b8929926d31a80c5add32a87a8df06e44ecad |

The harness persisted the tool stdout under the runtime projects directory; I wrote no files. Governing sources were the raw RC6 standards in the bound store, entered through the bootstrap entrypoint and the Reference Frame Baseline, Reference Frame Method, SPEC_METHOD, TICKET_METHOD, RELEASE_METHOD and Design Module Method, plus the Axiom Product, skill and output contract. No Representation map was supplied, so frames were selected directly from those standards.
